P.name: Living Forge
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Forge:}} '''Ornn''' can purchase [[item]]s from the [[shop]] even while outside of its range and from anywhere on the battlefield, by ''forging'' them. He is able to forge any non-[[consumable item|consumable]] item, and is also presented a ''Forge Menu'' to quickly forge his recommended items. Once '''Ornn''' attempts to purchase an item, he starts forging it, causing him to {{tip|channel}} for 4 seconds. Upon completion of the channel, he builds the item and pays its {{g|gold}} cost. The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} if '''Ornn''' takes damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}. ''Living Forge'' is disabled for 4 seconds after starting the channel.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Master Craftsman:}} '''Ornn''' uses his craftsmanship in forgery to upgrade {{tt|most|See notes}} [[Legendary item]]s that he and his teammates own into {{sbc|Masterwork}} items, increasing the [[Gold efficiency (League of Legends)|gold value]] of all {{tt|upgradeable stats|See notes}} on the item by exactly {{g|1000}}, shared equally among them. When '''Ornn''' reaches [[Experience (champion)|level]] 13, the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in his inventory is upgraded automatically. For each level after 13 and before 18 (levels 14–17, total of 4, once per ally per game), '''Ornn''' can upgrade the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in an allied champion's inventory into its {{sbc|Masterwork}} variant. He can do so by selecting the ally while within 600 range, and forges the item's upgrade by performing ''Living Forge's'' {{tip|channel}}.

Additionally, '''Ornn''' increases his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}} by 10% from all sources, further increased by 4% each time he upgrades a ''Legendary'' item into a {{sbc|Masterwork}} item, for a total increase of 30% to each stat after the maximum of 5 upgrades.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Temper:}} '''Ornn''' applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit by ''{{ai|Bellows Breath|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}''. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against enemies afflicted with ''Brittle'' are empowered to {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} a short distance over {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}. '''Ornn's''' and allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects or {{tip|silence|silences}} against ''Brittle'' enemies will consume the debuff to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|type='''Ornn's''' level|9 + (17-9)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|type=[[File:Bellows Breath.png|20px|border]] ''Bellows Breath's'' rank|200 to 500 for 6|0 to 5|formula=200 + 60 per rank of ''Bellows Breath''}} against {{tip|monsters}}, and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable).
P.description4: '''''Ornn''' will prioritize upgrading the first Legendary item eligible for a {{sbc|Masterwork}} upgrade based on its position in the inventory, detecting each slot until an eligible item is found.''

Q.name: Volcanic Rupture
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sends a fissure in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Q.description2: The fissure stops at maximum range or 200 units behind the first enemy champion struck. After a {{fd|1.125}}-second delay, a magma pillar then erupts at the location to {{tip|airborne|knock aside}} enemies, though not through terrain, and linger as impassible terrain for 4 seconds.
Q.description3: ''The pillar will not expire during {{ais|Searing Charge|Ornn}} dash.''

W.name: Bellows Breath
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|lunge|marches}} forward in the target direction over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, gaining {{tip|displacement immunity}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration.
W.description2: Over the march he belches fire over a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.15}} seconds to enemies hit. The final gout of flame can reach slightly farther and will apply {{tip|Brittle}} for 3 seconds.
W.description3: ''Bellows Breath'' has a minimum damage threshold, which is also the damage dealt to {{tip|minion|minions}}, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|12 to 16}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|12/5 to 16/5}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.leveling3:
{{st|Total Minimum/Minion Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}}|Minimum/Minion Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/5 to 280/5}}}}
{{st|Total Monster Damage Cap|{{ap|260 to 500}}|Monster Damage Cap Per Tick|{{ap|260/5 to 500/5}}}}

E.name: Searing Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through and stopping upon colliding with terrain.
E.description2: If '''Ornn''' collides with terrain during the charge, he creates a shockwave that {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} and {{tip|stuns}} nearby enemies for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and deals the same damage if they were not already hit by the charge.
E.description3: The shockwave destroys the pillar formed by ''{{ai|Volcanic Rupture|Ornn}}'' and partially destroys [[terrain]] created by enemy {{tip|champions}}.
E.description4: '''''Ornn''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the dash ends.''

R.name: Call of the Forge God
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sounds his horn, summoning a lava elemental at maximum range from the target direction that stampedes towards his casting position at increasing speed. The elemental deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
R.description2: ''Call of the Forge God'' can be recast after {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Includes the cast time}} seconds while the elemental is active.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain. If he collides with the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the same direction. The elemental deals the same damage to enemies it passes through and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second, reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
R.description4: Each pass applies {{tip|Brittle}} to targets for 3 seconds and can affect enemies only once. The elemental briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels.
